question: ‘Chang dance’ is popular in the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chang dance is also referred to as **Dhamal, **performed during festivals like Holi and Maha-Shivratri.
 
• Chang dance is named after the instrument "Chang"
 
• Rajasthan is known as the **cultural Capital **of India. Also referred to as the** "Abode of Rajas"**
 
• Other Folk dances of Rajasthan are **Ghoomar, Kalbeliya, Kachi Ghodi, Bhavai, Chari, Gair, and Kathputli**.
 
• Rajasthan is the** largest state** of India, followed by Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra.
